import awkward as ak
from pocket_coffea.workflows.base import BaseProcessor


class DimuonAnalysis(BaseProcessor):
    """Minimal PocketCoffea workflow for dimuon analysis"""
    
    def apply_object_preselection(self, df, year):
        """Create MuonGood collection with pT > 15 GeV and |eta| < 2.4"""
        muons = df.Muon
        muon_mask = (muons.pt > 15) & (ak.abs(muons.eta) < 2.4)
        df["MuonGood"] = muons[muon_mask]
        return df
    
    def count_objects(self, df, year):
        """Store number of selected muons per event"""
        df["nMuonGood"] = ak.num(df.MuonGood)
        return df


if __name__ == "__main__":
    processor = DimuonAnalysis()
    print("Dimuon analysis processor created successfully")
